name: re-sandbox
description: Containerized reverse-engineering toolkit for PE/ELF/Mach-O, Motorola DSP56300 firmware/ROMs, C++ RTTI/VTables, .NET, Android APK/DEX, Python, Go, WASM, and Electron binaries.
suggestedPrompts: Run initial triage, compiler/packer detection, and header entropy analysis on the binary in samples/
Recover C++ RTTI class hierarchies and VTable addresses from the binary in samples/
Disassemble the Motorola DSP56300 ROM in samples/ using dsp56300_disassemble and save the assembly to output/
Decompile the main entrypoint and key functions using Ghidra Headless
